title: Elmo Bedtime Storytime
description: Elmo sits up in bed wearing striped pajamas, holding a blue starry blanket with both hands. A glowing crescent moon, rubber duck, open storybook, and starry patterned bedding surround him in a whimsical children's bedroom at night.
prompt: Elmo from Sesame Street sitting up in a cozy bed at night wearing red and yellow striped pajamas, holding a blue blanket with yellow stars, large white eyes and orange nose, glowing cracked crescent moon in the dark purple starry sky visible through the window, rubber duck and open children's storybook on the bed, whimsical painted children's bedroom with patterned pillows and quilt, magical dreamy atmosphere, detailed digital painting style
